item.text:
Reconstructed the opening and six verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. The verses use Punjabi grammar, so I updated the language metadata from Urdu to Punjabi.

I read “tera” in verse 5 as تیرہ (“thirteen”). I verified that the opening and six numbered verses align in both scripts.
